# Brockmann in JGUI

This vendored snapshot is maintained against Brockmann revision
`14cacf9f5d2de5465bc6d1104a02a4eac318732c` at
https://github.com/riffifi/brockmann-ui-desktop. The vendor tree carries
JGUI-specific changes. Its manifest trims dependencies and its runtime
supports application-defined window dimensions and returning control to Ject
when a window closes. The vendored files are the build inputs.

Brockmann's MIT license is in `LICENSE`. The Geist fonts and icons carry
their own notices in `assets/fonts/OFL.txt` and `assets/icons/LICENSE`.
